The Chicken Scoop in downtown Clanton will close on Nov. 24, owner Rhonda Douglas announced on Facebook. The restaurant opened in February. Its commercial space, kitchen equipment and furnishings are for sale.

data.store_name: Kaia South African Restaurant and Wine Bar
data.status: permanently close by New Year's Eve
data.short_description: Kaia announced it will permanently close, with its last night on New Year's Eve. The owner cited challenges after moving from Third Avenue to First Avenue in 2026, plus personal losses. Biltong, catering and events will continue.
Makus Empanadas is closing its brand and Durham restaurant after 11 years. The owners said the last day will be Friday, Dec. 18.

data.location: Morgan Street Food Hall, downtown Raleigh

Heinen's closed its downtown Cleveland store in July, leaving shoppers with limited options. A new city study suggests micro-markets for downtown rather than one large grocery store.

Comanche Nation Entertainment will break ground on Dec. 2 on a multi-phase expansion of Comanche Nation Casino. The expansion will add a hotel, a new event center, a larger casino floor and more dining options.
Royal Borough planning officers approved M&S's plans for a food hall at Stafferton Way retail park. The Range unit there will be split into two, and one unit will house the food hall.

Chef Ouita Michel's Honeywood at Fritz Farm will close at the end of the year after a decade. Michel said it is closing "because we couldn't afford it," citing rising costs.

data.status: closing the last of the restaurants two locations
data.short_description: Vinaigrette Salad Kitchen is closing the last of its two locations this week after 12 years. The co-founder cited delivery-platform fees and fallout from a parasite outbreak that hurt public perception of salad restaurants.

Starbucks closed two locations in Lexington earlier this year.
Weigel's is building its first convenience store outside Tennessee, in Ringgold, Georgia. The 6,600-square-foot store will have six truck fueling bays.

Woodforest National Bank opened a full-service branch inside the H-E-B at 20025 Eva St. in Montgomery, Texas. It is the bank's eighth H-E-B branch and brings its network to 740 branches.

Famous Toastery in Carolina Forest will have its last day on Sunday, Nov. 29, after a decade in business. Owner and state Rep. Tim McGinnis is starting a new role at the Myrtle Beach Area Hospitality Association.
Dino's House of Pancakes, which is located in North Myrtle Beach, will open a second location in Famous Toastery's old space. The opening is planned for early December.
